Draw the back of each face too. Off, a face seen from behind is culled before it reaches the rasterizer, which is most of what a dense hair costs at close range.

Coverage is stochastic; needs

Weights the whole specular lobe. 1 is an ordinary dielectric; 0 is a surface with no reflection at all, which is what a Phong export with its specular switched off means.
What base-color alpha means: 0 is coverage (hair, foliage), 1 is transmission (glass), where the surface keeps its reflection however clear it is
